🔒 Important Examination Rules (Strict Section Lock & Timing):

  • Hierarchy: Selection Post ❯ Higher Secondary Level ❯ 18 Sep 2026 (Shift 2)
  • 15-Minute Sectional Timer: Har Section ke liye strictly 15:00 minute ka time limit nirdharit hai.
  • No Direct Section Switching: Aap bina vartamaan (current) section ko Submit kiye kisi doosre section me switch nahi kar sakte. Sabhi anya sections locked rahenge.
  • Auto-Submission: 15 minute samapt hote hi vartamaan section automatic submit ho jayega aur agla section start ho jayega.
  • No Re-visit after Submit: Ek baar section submit ho jaane ke baad uske questions me dubara koi parivartan nahi kiya ja sakta.

12 Question number shown in blue color indicates that you have not yet attempted the question.

Save & Next Clicking on this will take you to the next question.
Previous Clicking on this will take you to the previous question.
Mark for Review By clicking on this button, you can mark the question for review later. Please note that if you answer the question and mark for review, the question will be treated as answered and evaluated even if you do not review it.
Unmark Review By clicking on this button, you can unmark the question for review
Clear Response By clicking Clear Response button to remove the selected answer.
